SELECT DISTINCT f.RmChgTrn
FROM dbo.Folio f
WHERE f.ExternalConfirmNumber IN (@Keys0)
  AND ISNULL(f.RmChgTrn, 0) <> 0

SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(TransactionCode)) AS Code, LTRIM(RTRIM(TransactionSubCode)) AS Sub,
       ISNULL(AutoPost, 0) AS AutoPost
FROM dbo.TransactionCode;

SELECT DISTINCT CONVERT(varchar(12), TrnCode) AS Code, CONVERT(varchar(12), ISNULL(TrnSubCode, 0)) AS Sub
FROM dbo.RoomType
WHERE ISNULL(TrnCode, 0) <> 0;

SELECT DISTINCT LTRIM(RTRIM(TrnCode)) AS Code, LTRIM(RTRIM(TrnSubCode)) AS Sub
FROM dbo.PackageCode
WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(TrnCode)), '') IS NOT NULL;

SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(ParaName)) AS Code, LTRIM(RTRIM(ParaString)) AS Sub
FROM dbo.GlobalParameter
WHERE ParaName IN ('EBedSurChgTrnCode', 'EBedSurChgTrnSub');

SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(TrnCode)) AS Code, LTRIM(RTRIM(TrnSubCode)) AS Sub
FROM dbo.SpecialService
WHERE SpecialServiceCode = @ExtraBedCode
  AND ISNULL(IncludeInRoomCharge, 0) = 0
  AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(TrnCode)), '') IS NOT NULL;

SELECT t.TransactionCode,
       ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(t.TransactionSubCode)), ''), '0') AS TransactionSubCode,
       tc.Description, t.TransactionAmount AS Amount,
       CASE WHEN (t.TransactionCode IN (@EarnAny0) OR (t.TransactionCode = @EarnC0 AND ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(t.TransactionSubCode)), ''), '0') = @EarnS0)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Qualifies
FROM Folio f
JOIN FolioTransaction t ON t.FolioNum = CONVERT(varchar(20), f.FolioNum)
LEFT JOIN TransactionCode tc ON tc.TransactionCode = t.TransactionCode
    AND tc.TransactionSubCode = ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(t.TransactionSubCode)), ''), '0')
WHERE f.ExternalConfirmNumber = @Ext
  AND ISNULL(f.CancelNum, 0) = 0
  AND f.FolioStatus = 3
  AND t.FolioBalanceCode = 'A'

SELECT 'O' AS K, LTRIM(RTRIM(f.OriginCode)) AS V FROM Folio f
  WHERE f.ExternalConfirmNumber = @Key AND ISNULL(f.CancelNum, 0) = 0
UNION
SELECT 'S', LTRIM(RTRIM(f.MarketSegmentCode)) FROM Folio f
  WHERE f.ExternalConfirmNumber = @Key AND ISNULL(f.CancelNum, 0) = 0
UNION
SELECT 'R', LTRIM(RTRIM(f.RoomRateCode)) FROM Folio f
  WHERE f.ExternalConfirmNumber = @Key AND ISNULL(f.CancelNum, 0) = 0

SELECT MAX(CheckOutTime)
FROM Folio
WHERE ISNULL(CancelNum, 0) = 0
  AND ExternalConfirmNumber = @Code
